phase: bars, committed before the prediction and before any run
baseline: rolling clean (owner's decision 2026-10-10): the same hour of day on up to 7 earlier clean days within 28; at least 3 or no verdict; the seed fortnight Aug 3-16 is judged against its own other days
evidence: automation/runs/m1-s4/seed_spread.json (each seed hour's ratio to its seed reference)

QUALITY_VOLUME_LOW.argument: Seed volume ratios: p2.5 0.435, natural minimum 0.406 (2026-08-06-14, weekday working hours; push share normal at 0.957). Everything below 0.40 is 2026-08-07 09:00-15:00 (0.24-0.30), one contiguous block running into that day's push collapse: an incident, not a dip. Near-empty hours (M0-S2: < 5 MB gzipped) sit near 0.01. 0.35 is below every natural dip and above the incident.

QUALITY_VOLUME_HIGH.argument: Seed maximum 1.383 (p99.5 1.362). A spike loses no data, so the bar is generous: 2.0.

QUALITY_MIX_MIN_SHARE.argument: Types at 1-3% of the reference swing far from noise alone: CreateEvent 0.25-3.19, DeleteEvent 0.24-4.30 (clusters on Aug 11-13). A band wide enough for them (>= 4.3x) could not catch the Aug 7 push incident (needs < 3.4x). Judging only types with >= 5% of the reference keeps the bar meaningful; in the seed that is PushEvent alone, later CreateEvent joins when it grows.

QUALITY_MIX_LOW.argument: PushEvent share ratio in the seed: p2.5 0.922, median 1.000, max 1.033; its low tail is 2026-08-07 16:00-19:00 (0.149-0.553). 0.6 sits between the natural floor (0.92) and the incident (<= 0.55).

QUALITY_MIX_HIGH.argument: The log-mirror of 0.6 (1/0.6), so a share rising as far as one falling is judged alike. PushEvent cannot exceed ~1.05 of a 0.95 reference anyway; the bar matters for CreateEvent once it reaches 5%.

QUALITY_REFERENCE_SIZE.argument: One week of the same hour of day: covers both weekend and weekday behaviour; the median is robust to a single odd day.

QUALITY_MIN_REFERENCE.argument: A median of fewer than 3 is not a baseline; such an hour gets no verdict rather than a guess.

QUALITY_LOOKBACK_DAYS.argument: Long enough to reach past the longest broken stretch seen (Sep 2-10) for clean references.
